title: TCGer CardGeometryReleaseManifest v1
description: One immutable card-geometry corpus release: every record and image with its hash, the split and leakage keys of each record, the readiness policy the release binds to, and the purpose the release may be used for. The manifest is the unit a preflight validates and a training job pins.

releasePurpose.description: What this release may authorize. `fixture` and `smoke` releases exercise tooling only and can never make a preflight report `readyFor: training`, regardless of how small the bound readiness policy's minimums are.

corpusHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON serialization of this manifest with the `corpusHash` member removed (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8). Because every record and image hash is a member, this hash identifies the complete corpus content.

readinessPolicySha256.description: SHA-256 of the readiness policy file bytes.

evaluationSessionDenylist.description: Session ids frozen for evaluation. A record from one of these sessions may appear only in the `test` split.

relativePath.description: Path relative to the release root. No absolute paths and no parent traversal.

leakageKeys.description: Keys that must never be shared between splits. They duplicate values inside the record so leakage can be checked from the manifest alone, and the preflight verifies the duplicates agree with the record.

sceneSlice.description: Evaluation slice this frame belongs to, for example `single_handheld`, `steep_playmat`, `duel_field`, `binder_page`.
